scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @flowproof/database generate && concurrently -k -n web,worker,portal -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm --filter @flowproof/web dev" "pnpm --filter @flowproof/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @flowproof/demo-portal dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @flowproof/database generate && pnpm --filter @flowproof/web build && pnpm --filter @flowproof/worker build && pnpm --filter @flowproof/demo-portal build
scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm browser:install
